German Academic Scholarship Foundation (Studienstiftung des deutschen Volkes) scholarships for international students, 2026-27

International scholarships, fellowships or grants are offered to students outside the country where the university is located. These are also called as financial aid and many times the financial aid office of the German Academic Scholarship Foundation (Studienstiftung des deutschen Volkes) deals with it. German Academic Scholarship Foundation (Studienstiftung des deutschen Volkes) scholarships are offered by German Academic Scholarship Foundation (Studienstiftung des deutschen Volkes) to study or research there.

There are various German Academic Scholarship Foundation (Studienstiftung des deutschen Volkes) scholarships for international students. Apart from the university-based scholarships, there are many other organizations including foundations, trusts, corporates etc. Who offer scholarships for international students. To help, we list out the latest international scholarships, fellowships and grants information. The German Academic Scholarship Foundation (Studienstiftung des deutschen Volkes) scholarships application form is also available to apply online for the scholarships.
